name: Shadcnship
summary: Shadcn/ui block registry with 60+ responsive landing-page and SaaS blocks for Next.js.
description: A collection of production-ready blocks — hero, features, pricing, CTA, stats, logos, testimonials, FAQ, navbar, footer and more — built with shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Next.js and TypeScript. Each block installs with the shadcn CLI and copies into your project, themed by your own shadcn tokens.
contains: feature 19, hero 6, stats 6, CTA 5, background 5, pricing 4, testimonials 4
plus auth, blog, team, integration, comparison, banner, changelog and cookie blocks
waitlist block: email capture with validation wired to Supabase/PostgreSQL
each block installs with the shadcn CLI; MIT, the code becomes yours
built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
